gridDNA: A dominant central product shot with a large, two-line headline anchored top-left, and a high-contrast offer badge positioned mid-left, all against a clean, light background with a dynamic foreground element.

zones.note: provides clean stage for product and text

zones.position: top-left, starting 10% from top, 10% from left
zones.treatment: dark grey, sans-serif, regular weight, title case
zones.note: first line of a two-line headline

zones.position: below headline, left-aligned, starting 17% from top, 10% from left
zones.treatment: bright accent colour, sans-serif, bold weight, lowercase
zones.note: punchy, contrasting second line of headline

zones.position: vertically centred, horizontally offset 10% to the right of centre, base at 60% from top
mid-left, behind offer badge, starting 35% from top, 5% from left
zones.note: supports the bundle offer, secondary product display

zones.position: mid-left, above main offer text, starting 38% from top, 5% from left
zones.treatment: white text on solid accent colour pill-shaped container, uppercase

zones.position: mid-left, below offer label, starting 43% from top, 5% from left
zones.treatment: white text on solid black rectangular container, bold, uppercase, large font
zones.note: the primary value proposition, high contrast

zones.position: bottom-centre, starting 60% from top, spanning ~50% of canvas width
zones.note: adds a dynamic, relatable element, grounds the product

zones.position: bottom-left, starting 92% from top, 5% from left
zones.treatment: dark grey, very small font, regular weight
zones.note: standard legal disclaimer, minimal visual weight

typeScale: headline ~10% of canvas height, sub ~7%, offer text ~6%, offer label ~2%, legal ~1%
colourBlocking: Top 20% is mostly negative space with dark text. Mid-section is dominated by the silver product and a strong red/black offer block. Bottom 40% is negative space with a brown foreground element and small legal text. The background is a consistent light neutral.
negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the top-right and bottom-right, allowing the headline and product to breathe and stand out. The clean, light background emphasizes the foreground elements.
eyePath: Headline -> Subheadline -> Offer Badge (text) -> Product (main) -> Product (bundle) -> Prop/Foreground Element -> Legal/Disclaimer
whyItWins: The clear, bold problem/solution headline combined with an unmissable, high-value offer badge and a hero product shot creates immediate visual impact and communicates value quickly.
